question: i forgot my e-learning password
expected_answer: Click Lost Password, search with your username or email, open the reset link sent to your email and set a new password
bot_answer: **How to reset a forgotten E‑Learning password**  1. Go to the University of Embu E‑Learning login page: **https://e-learning.embuni.ac.ke/**.   2. Click on **“Lost Password.”**   3. Enter **either** your **Username** (your admission number, e.g., *e223/100/2000* – first letter lower‑case) **or** the **E‑mail address** you used when creating the account.   4. Click **“Search.”**   5. A confirmation page will tell you that a reset link has been sent to the email address you registered.   6. Open your student email (e.g., *100@student.embuni.ac.ke*) and locate the message from **Admin User (via UoEm Elearning Portal) <nonreply@embuni.ac.ke>**.   7. Click the link in that email.   8. On the new page, type a **new password** that follows the university password policy (mix of a capital letter, numbers and special characters such as #, @, $).   9. Click **“Save changes.”**    You can now log in to the E‑Learning platform with your admission number and the new password.    If you encounter any problems, contact the ICT team at **support.ict@embuni.ac.ke** or **dir.ict@embuni.ac.ke**.
